segments.name: Title
segments.vo: This is SpecCheck. It checks construction submittals against the project spec and the manufacturer's live website, and tells you exactly what to send instead.

segments.name: Context
segments.vo: Before a product goes into a building, the subcontractor sends its data sheets, called a submittal, and someone has to check every line against the architect's spec. Miss something and it comes back revise and resubmit, and the job loses weeks.

segments.name: Scan
segments.vo: So I drop in the package and press Scan. NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano sorts the pages. Nemotron 3 Super reads every value with its exact quote. Tavily pulls each manufacturer's current documents. Both models run on Nebius Token Factory, and code makes every decision.

segments.name: Catch 1 (c02)
segments.vo: This firestop system has a two-hour fire rating but a zero-hour temperature rating. The spec needs them to match, so SpecCheck says exactly what to send: a listed system rated two hours for both.

detail.text: T 0 hr, but the spec needs T = F (2 hr)

segments.name: Catch 2 (c03)
segments.vo: This sealant sheet is from 2005. The manufacturer's current sheet raised the service temperature from 120 to 180 degrees. What to send: the current data sheet.

segments.name: Catch 3 (c07)
segments.vo: This light fixture was approved in March 2024. One click re-checks it against the manufacturer's site. It was discontinued that June, and their notice is quoted right here. What to send: a current product that meets the spec.

segments.label: Live

segments.name: Under the hood
segments.vo: Under the hood, every value has to be quoted from the page it came from, and code compares it to the spec. Anything unproven goes to a person, never faked.

segments.name: Under the hood (trace)
segments.vo: And every call is traced: which model, how many tokens, what it cost.

segments.name: How it runs
segments.vo: It's live, served through Vercel from a Nebius Serverless Endpoint with persistent storage. Spend is reserved before every call, and approved products are re-checked every day.

segments.vo: The reviewer gets one printable memo for the whole package.
